summary.text: Father of Pelasgian Lethus (`lethus-pelasgian`) and grandfather of the captains Hippothous and Pylaeus — attested by Homer when the spear-raging Pelasgi from deep-soiled Larisa muster among the Trojan allies.

story.text: Homer's Catalogue names Teutamus only through his son's line: Hippothous and Pylaeus, scions of Ares, sons twain of Pelasgian Lethus, son of Teutamus, led the Pelasgi who dwelt in deep-soiled Larisa to the war at Troy.
